# JoinTheEvent

> JoinTheEvent is an open-source event management platform inspired by events platform. Hosts create, manage, and share events — by hand or by chatting with an AI agent — and guests discover events, RSVP, and get QR code tickets. Built with Next.js 16, PostgreSQL + Drizzle, Better Auth, and the Vercel AI SDK. MIT licensed.

## Key features

- AI event agent: create, edit, search, and manage events in natural language
- Public event discovery with filtering by type and date
- RSVPs with approval, capacity limits, waitlists, and QR code tickets
- Host, co-host, and attendee roles; private invite-only events
- Email invitations and confirmations with calendar (.ics) attachments
- QR code check-in for attendees

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jointheevent.vercel.app/): What JoinTheEvent is and how to get started
- [Discover events](https://jointheevent.vercel.app/events): Upcoming public events
- Event page (`/e/{slug}`): Details, host, location, and RSVP for a single public event
- Host profile (`/u/{userId}`): A host's public profile and their public events
- [Sign in](https://jointheevent.vercel.app/sign-in): Email or Google sign-in to host or RSVP
